content: Gossipsub RPC spec defines repeated string subscriptions with NO protocol-imposed count bound; implementations must self-defend. Go gossipsub has no explicit per-peer subscription cap - it relies on ignoring messages for unsubscribed topics plus the libp2p resource manager for memory bounds. The GNUS C++ fork has neither resource manager nor sub cap; remote_subscriptions.hpp TODO(artem) proposes bounding the table by pruning topics not locally subscribed (LRU). An explicit cap with ignore-excess policy is strictly stronger than current C++ state.
